tight setting, visible structure, type-only hero, no giant size

014 · 2.4 MB · 18 KB014 · 2.4 MB · 18 KB

Columns line up because the index is mono; the sans gets tabular figures for sizes.
Signature
The structure is the type: a 44 px bold title in a system-metric face, a hard-ruled index table, browser-blue underlined links. Hierarchy from weight and position; nothing is large.
Use when
Artists and architects, archives, protest and zine sites, internal tools that should look like what they are.
Turns into slop when
When it is applied to a consumer product as a costume, when a single rotated sticker or neon accent is added to "spice it up", or when the table is fake.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
